label: Custom element
description: One element the author defines under a label of their own, for anything the other kinds do not hold: what it is, why the book needs it, which details must stay consistent and what is still undecided.

fields.label: What it is and why it matters
fields.help: What this element is, in a line, and why the book needs it rather than doing without it.

fields.label: Where it lives
fields.help: Whether the element exists inside the story's world, in how the story is told, in the matter around the story, or only in the author's planning.

options.label: In how the story is told
In the matter around the story
Behind the page, for planning only

fields.label: Details to keep consistent
fields.help: The facts about this element that must read the same wherever it appears, one per item.

fields.label: Parts of the book it touches
fields.help: The plotlines, characters, places, chapters or other elements this one touches, and what it does in each.

fields.label: Presence on the page
fields.help: How much of the book this element is visible in, from a rare mention to a constant presence.

fields.label: First appearance
fields.help: Where in the book the reader first meets this element, and how much of it shows at that moment.

fields.label: Planned changes
fields.help: Any deliberate change to this element between the opening and the end, so it is not later mistaken for a slip in its details.

fields.label: Open questions
fields.help: What is still to be decided about this element, one question per item.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Anything else worth keeping about this element that no other field holds, in the author's own words.

fields.label: How they fit together
fields.help: What each contributes to the other, and how the part sits within the whole.

fields.label: What sets them apart
fields.help: What one holds that the other lacks, so that the two never blur together.

fields.label: What sets them apart
fields.help: What one holds that the other lacks, so that the two never blur together.

fields.label: What is drawn from it
fields.help: Which facts, methods or details pass from the source into the book.

fields.label: Liberties taken
fields.help: Where the book departs from the source on purpose, and why.

fields.label: How one leads to the other
fields.help: The chain from the first to the second: what makes the second follow from it, rather than merely come after it.

fields.label: What the reader sees of the link
fields.help: Whether the reader notices the connection as it happens, later on, or only when looking back.

fields.label: What lies between them
fields.help: What happens, or is deliberately left out, between the first and the second.

fields.label: Where they meet or part
fields.help: The point on which the two stand against each other: one question answered two ways.

fields.label: What the comparison reveals
fields.help: What a reader understands from setting the two side by side that neither shows alone.
